name: AWS CLI
description: Installs the AWS CLI v2 into the workspace and provides a settings panel for AWS credentials (access key, secret key, region, session token — applied via `aws configure`).

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID (aws configure set aws_access_key_id).

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key. Never stored in plain config — routed to the zero-knowledge secret store.

aws_default_region.description: Default AWS region (aws configure set region).

aws_session_token.description: Optional AWS session token, for temporary/STS credentials. Never stored in plain config.
